questions.stem: Which of the following foramen is located between three bones?
questions.solutionHtml:
Foramen Lacerum

The foramen lacerum is an irregular foramen located in the middle cranial fossa, posteromedial to the foramen ovale. 

Foramen lacerum is bound by 3 bones

  • Medially by the basilar part of occipital bone
  • Posterolaterally by apex of petrous part of the temporal bone
  • Anteriorly by the pterygoid process and Greater wing of sphenoid (central body)



Gray's Anatomy for Students International Edition, 4th Edition Page No.850.

questions.stem: Which of the following structures passing through jugular foramen has a separate canal?
questions.solutionHtml:

  • CN IX pierces through the endosteal layer of dura mater, passes through jugular foramen as a separate canal.

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a branch of the facial artery?
questions.solutionHtml:
Mental
  • The mental artery is a terminal branch of the inferior alveolar artery arising from the maxillary artery. It often communicates with the submental and inferior labial arteries branching off the facial artery.
  • The image is clearly showing the mental artery as a branch of maxillary artery - so the answer is mental artery here 

Mental artery

questions.stem: Arrangement of the structures in anterior to posterior relations at lung hilum?

options.label: A
options.text: Pulmonary Vein, Pulmonary Artery, Bronchus, Bronchial Artery

options.label: B
options.text: Pulmonary Vein, Bronchus, Pulmonary Artery, Bronchial Artery

options.label: C
options.text: Pulmonary Artery, Bronchial Artery, Bronchus, Pulmonary Vein

options.label: D
options.text: Bronchus, Bronchial Artery, Pulmonary Artery, Pulmonary Vein

questions.answerText: Pulmonary Vein, Pulmonary Artery, Bronchus, Bronchial Artery
questions.solutionHtml:
Pulmonary Vein, Pulmonary Artery, Bronchus, Bronchial Artery
  • The chief structures composing the root of each lung are arranged in a similar manner from the front to the back on each side.
  • This means that the upper of the two pulmonary veins are located anteriorly, the pulmonary artery is in the middle, and the bronchus and bronchial vessels are located posteriorly.


Gray's Anatomy for Students International Edition, 4th Edition Page No. 171.

questions.stem: The ligament connecting medial cuneiform and second metatarsal is ?
questions.solutionHtml:
Lisfranc Ligament
  • Lisfranc ligament connects the medial cuneiform bone to the second metatarsal and maintains proper alignment between the metatarsal bones and the tarsal bones.
  • It acts as a shock absorber during the weight bearing phase of the bipedal gait cycle.
  • It also compensates for the lack of an intermetatarsal ligament between the first metatarsal bone and the second metatarsal bone.


Gray's Anatomy for Students International Edition, 4th Edition Page No.641.
